description: Vercel is a deployment and hosting platform with a REST API for projects, deployments and domains.
auth_notes: Vercel Access Tokens sent in the Authorization: Bearer header. Sign in with Vercel OAuth/OIDC API permissions are private beta.
gate_detail: Access Tokens are created by the developer in account settings. Plan requirements are not stated in the available text. OAuth-based API Permissions for third-party apps are in private beta and need access.
api_scope: Manage deployments, domains, projects, environment variables and secrets, teams, webhooks and more over HTTPS at api.vercel.com; an SDK is also referenced.
mcp_notes: Vercel docs navigation lists a 'Vercel MCP' page; no URL or details in sources.
blocker_detail: Personal access tokens are self-created; only OAuth API Permissions for acting on behalf of other users are gated by a private beta.

evidence.quote: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API. Include the token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
Create and manage Access Tokens in your account settings .
All endpoints live under the URL https://api.vercel.com and follow the REST architecture.
Per the docs those API Permissions are in private beta, and they aren't exposed in our app's Permissions settings yet

uncertainties: Sources do not state whether a free plan suffices for token creation.
MCP status inferred only from a navigation label; no URL or details.
Sandbox nav item appears to be a product, not an API test environment.
OAuth for acting on behalf of users is private beta.
